---
name: Idea / concept proposal / 想法或方案提案
about: Propose a design idea, a concept, or a change to the shared criteria / 提出设计想法、新方案或共享判据修改
labels: idea
---

**Hypothesis / 假设** — what you think would work and why / 你认为什么可行、为什么

**How it could be falsified / 如何证伪** — the test or calculation that would kill it / 能否定它的试验或计算

**Expected numbers / 预期数字** — with sources or marked ASSUMED / 附来源，或标注 ASSUMED

**Shared criteria affected / 影响的共享判据** (e.g. avail, headClear, keMax …)

**Safety & legal notes / 安全与法规** (people, roads, airspace, resorts / 人群、道路、空域、雪场)
